about_the_game:
Welcome to Fish to Dish: Idle Sushi! This is a relaxing and enjoyable idle fishing game that can sit at the bottom or any corner of your screen, allowing you to enjoy a leisurely sea fishing time in your busy life. You will become an angler under the blue sky, catching all kinds of strange marine life, and turning them into delicious sushi and serve your customers. Upgrade your fishing rod, unlock new bait, explore new ocean, and build your own marine aquarium!

Desktop Idle Fishing:

Start your leisurely sea fishing journey in a corner of your desktop, watching the fishing boat automatically go out to sea and reap a full harvest.

Anytime, anywhere, without pressure or burden, easily enjoy the joy of a full fish harvest.

Explore the ocean, Collect Exotic Fish:

Sail into mysterious bays and discover a variety of marine life, from common fish to rare sea monsters.

All kinds of strange marine floating objects? Yes, from starfish and walruses to turtles, even rubber ducks, and more!

Compelet your fish book, unlock new fish species, and enrich your sushi menu. Gotta catch'em all!

Run a Sushi Restaurant, Serve Your Customers:

Turn the fish you catch into delicious sushi, sell it to customers, and earn gold coins.

Upgrade your sushi level, use a variety of unique decorations and furniture to create a unique sushi restaurant, and attract more customers (cats?).

Upgrade Fishing Rods, Unlock New Baits:

Use hard earned coins to upgrade your fishing rod, improve fishing efficiency, and make every trip to sea a rewarding one!

Choose the right bait to lock onto target fish class and catch rarer fish.

Chill Idle, Enjoy A Little:

Experience a relaxed idle life in the game, enjoy the fun of fishing, and feel the tranquility of the ocean.

Build your own sea fishing farm, watch the rare fish you collect, and enjoy a peaceful sea area that belongs to you.

In Fish to Dish: Idle Sushi, put down your busy life, return to nature, and enjoy your leisurely fishing time.
